candidates.name: AMBRA_T1_micro_01
candidates.design_strategy: jig-free cyclic peptide, disulfide between the terminal cysteines, canonical residues only, selected on measured imidazolium engagement
candidates.validation_protocol: the delivered fold is itself jig-free on an unmodified histidine - no covalent jig and no force-atomization - so the sequence scored is the sequence one would make. It carried the real disulfide, a chain-level 10 A pocket on the target histidine, and a residue-level site contact at each acceptor position; those state where the binder goes, not the interaction that was measured
candidates.notes: acceptor separation 6; binder engages a ring nitrogen in 2 of 5 models, both nitrogens in 2; binder radius of gyration 1.04x the compact expectation for its length; long-range contacts spread over 6 registers with an anti-diagonal fraction of 0.542, so it is not a two-strand hairpin
